name: combat-retreat
description: Retreat timing (LRR 78; combat-ux RetreatRules): mentak announces a retreat at the start of a round in its space combat at 306 (pbd60@165: 306 is not the active system; RetreatRules finds the player's combat there), and an immediate retreat is refused on both forks: the retreat happens at the end of the announced round. combat-retreat-end-of-round covers the retreat itself.
